div.div:
Auth mechanism
Access JWT (15 min) in memory, sent as Bearer
Refresh token: rotating httpOnly cookie gd_refresh,
path /api/auth, SameSite=Lax, stored hashed
30-day refresh, 90-day absolute session,
token_version revocation; X-Device-Id header

div.div:
API
[Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2 async]
modules: identity, deeds, media (M3), feed (M3)
/api/health, /api/auth/*, /api/users/*
/api/scans, /api/deeds, /api/me/deeds,
/api/me/self-logs, invites (switched off, D17)
M3 media: /api/media/options, uploads (+ complete),
deeds/{id}/photos, self-logs/{id}/photos,
photos/{id} (DELETE), photos/{id}/reports
M3 feed: /api/feed (+ options, deeds/{id}, likes,
saves, shares, comments, hide/show, notices),
/api/public/deeds/{id} (no login, no-store, noindex),
/api/users/{handle}/follow, /social; /api/me/saved,
/api/me/followers, /api/me/following
M3 review (moderator or admin):
/api/admin/photo-reports, /api/admin/photos/{id}/restore,
/api/admin/comment-reports, /api/admin/comments/{id}/restore
Postgres rate limits, limits from config rows,
outbox emit, audit log; token paths redacted

div.div:
PostgreSQL 16 + PostGIS 3.4
core: outbox_events, processed_events,
audit_log, rate_limits, config_versions
identity: users, consents, doer_codes,
oauth_accounts, phone_otps, refresh_tokens,
user_devices, phone_history
deeds: qr_scans, same_act_groups, deeds (+ area_id),
invites, verification_events, deed_revisions,
self_logs, areas (M3)
media (M3): photos, photo_report_cases,
photo_reports, photo_decisions
feed (M3): feed_posts, feed_likes, feed_comments,
feed_saves, feed_shares, follows, feed_notices_seen,
feed_top_snapshots, feed_top_entries,
comment_report_cases, comment_reports, comment_decisions
+ Procrastinate job schema (head 0018)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.div:
Worker [Procrastinate] (one worker, all queues)
core.dispatch_outbox (every 5 s), core.handle_event
identity.purge_expired_records (03:17)
deeds.expire_invites (15 min), deeds.purge_unconsumed_scans (03:37)
M3 media queue: media.process_queued (every 5 s),
media.move_objects (1 min), media.purge_deleted (5 min),
media.sweep_late_puts (5 min), media.expire_uploads (30 min),
media.purge_detached (hourly), media.purge_removed (02:23),
media.sweep_staging (02:53)
M3 feed: feed.refresh_top (every min, per period when due),
feed.erase_deleted_comments (03:47)
handlers: DeedVerified / DeedWithdrawn / DeedRejected → feed
